title: Hold a builder's licence
what: Hold the state's builder (or building contractor) licence or registration before contracting for or carrying out building work.

sources.title: Building Work Contractors Act 1995 (SA)
sources.publisher: Official register text via the Open Australian Legal Corpus
sources.quote: A person must not— (a) carry on business as a building work contractor except as authorised by a licence under this Part;

reach.note: Calibration: house construction; other building classes follow in phase D.
